Project Management Engineer Job at BlueChip Technologies




        
    

        
        BlueChip Technologies is a leading business application firm focused exclusively on assisting organizations in planning, designing, implementing and operating business application solutions and strategies that are central to creating and maintaining a competitive business advantage.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Project Management Engineer 

Job Location: Lagos
Job Type: Contract

Job Summary
     

            
    




	As part of our continuous growth, we are seeking experienced Project Management Engineers to champion the successful execution of IT infrastructure projects.
	The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise, strong leadership skills, and a proven ability to manage complex, high-impact projects within dynamic enterprise environments.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and maintain detailed project plans and schedules; coordinate updates with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery.
	Lead and supervise the project execution team, ensuring milestones, deliverables, and timelines are achieved.
	Manage IT infrastructure projects encompassing networks, servers, virtualization, storage, and data center operations in a high-availability, ITIL-based environment.
	Oversee the full project lifecycle — from requirements definition, planning, and execution to transition and closure.
	Ensure smooth handover of completed projects to operations teams with comprehensive documentation and drawings.
	Manage project budgets, financials, and resource utilization to achieve delivery within agreed constraints.
	Identify, assess, and mitigate risks and issues throughout project execution.
	Facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings and participate in major incident and problem reviews.
	Conduct regular project reviews to assess performance, resourcing, and process compliance, and recommend improvements.
	Prepare and maintain key project documents, including charters, communication plans, and progress reports.
	Provide accurate project status updates and delivery performance reports to management and stakeholders.
	Foster collaboration across teams, resolving conflicts, aligning objectives, and ensuring accountability.
	Translate technical initiatives into measurable business outcomes, ensuring that project outcomes align with organizational goals.
	Actively contribute to workforce planning, capacity reviews, and project delivery governance.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of relevant post-NYSC experience in project management within the Telecommunications or Technology industry.
	Proven experience managing complex IT infrastructure projects in a fast-paced, high-availability environment.
	Strong knowledge of infrastructure technologies including networks, servers, storage, data centers, and virtualization.
	Excellent understanding of project management frameworks (e.g., PMBOK, PRINCE2, Agile) and ITIL principles.
	Exceptional organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
	Demonstrated ability to influence and gain the respect of senior technical teams and stakeholders.
	Strong communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
	Project Management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile) is an added advantage.

  "description": "Amaiden Energy Nigeria Limited (formerly Moody International Nigeria Limited) was established in 1996 as a partnership between Moody International Group and Nigerian investors. Since commencing operations in March 1997 the company continues to grow and exerts its presence in numerous Projects in the Nigeria Oil and Gas Industry.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Electrical &amp; Electronics Engineer

Job Location: Lagos

Description


	Coordinate and oversee the maintenance, reliability, and performance of electrical and electromechanical systems across Company facilities, ensuring safe, efficient, and uninterrupted operations. Manage contractor performance, technical service delivery, maintenance planning, procurement, and budget execution while ensuring compliance with HSE standards, contractual requirements, and operational best practices to optimize asset reliability, cost efficiency, and customer satisfaction.


Task and Responsibilities
Electrical / Electromechanical Systems Management:


	Coordinate and monitor all electrical/electromechanical maintenance works (corrective and preventive)
	Ensure PPM schedules are respected, reports analyzed, and all anomalies closed out
	Manage equipment including lifts (22 units), UPS (31 units), fire pumps, smoke detection, fire alarm systems, sprinkler systems, fire suppression systems
	Ensure optimal availability and safe operation of all systems
	Execute and supervise preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities on electrical systems.
	Ensure continuous operation of electrical infrastructure supporting business activities.
	Monitor system health and performance to prevent failures and downtime.
	Ensure complete maintenance documentation and asset history records.
	Support emergency response activities during utility failures.


Contractor Management &amp; Supervision:


	Indirectly supervise 4 Facility Management Companies (110+ technical personnel)
	Coordinate FM services contracts across Deep Water Logistics Base and other locations
	Assist in coordinating FM Contracts in all company owned and leased sites
	Ensure contractor compliance with technical standards and HSE requirements
	Monitor contractor performance against SLAs


Budget &amp; Cost Management:


	Assist in preparation of annual Technical Facilities management budget
	Follow up on cost performance against budget
	Ensure works carried out within budget and cost-efficiently
	Develop and implement cost reduction initiatives
	Analyze/verify quotes to maximize value and cost-effectiveness
	Review and recommend internal commitment on Work Orders
	Provide technical approval on invoices


Procurement &amp; Contracts:


	Prepare Call for Tender (CFT) documents
	Review technical specifications with Manager
	Launch CFT and follow up with C&amp;P department
	Evaluate contractor bids and make recommendations
	Ensure prompt approval of Vendor Job Orders


Services Delivery &amp; User Support:


	Ensure all electrical/electromechanical work requests completed satisfactorily within SLA
	Conduct and document regular facilities inspections
	Provide prompt response to requests and issues from users
	Ensure feedback provided to requesters
	Generate snag lists for new projects and ensure closeout


Specialized Systems Coordination:


	Coordinate maintenance of industrial kitchen equipment (cold rooms inclusive)
	Manage ATS Panels with integrated backup switching for IST data center
	Oversee power installation and distribution management systems
	Coordinate water and sewage treatment plant operations
	Interface with other entities for technical facility services.
	Perform any other duties that may be assigned by hierarchy.


HSE Leadership:


	Coordinate HSE activities and report for the department
	Ensure Company HSE objectives met through PTW system
	Plan and conduct safety drills
	Enforce contractor compliance on safety awareness
	Manage Permit to Work processes for electrical works


Office Space MANAGEMENT SUPPORT:


	Assist in office space management works
	Modify fire safety protection systems for occupants
	Configure localized power interface systems
	Support facility modifications and reconfigurations


Projects and Technical Upgrades:


	Participate in facility upgrade and expansion projects.
	Prepare technical specifications and scopes of work.
	Review engineering drawings, schematics, and technical documentation.
	Support contractor evaluations and technical bid reviews.
	Monitor project execution and compliance with specifications.
	Participate in commissioning and acceptance testing activities.
	Contributes to ensuring equipment reliability and availability as a measure of service quality.


HSE Objectives:


	Closely related to HSE in operations to help in guaranteeing safe work processes and environment.
	Assists in the close out of all pending Synergy actions/recommendations.
	Familiarize self with Company&#39;s emergency procedures, carry out assigned responsibilities safely and report any incident, unsafe act or operation.
	Support the anomaly and downgraded situations tracking and closure process.
	Supports the Permit to Work (PTW) process &amp; Perfect Day initiative at its location.
	Assists in ensuring closure of outstanding Synergy recommendations


Job Requirements


	Good HND or university degree in electrical electronics engineering.
	Minimum of 8-12 years post NYSC professional work experience.
	Trained or certified auditor
	Experience in operations and maintenance of commercial buildings, industrial facilities, oil &amp; gas installations, airports, hotels, hospitals, or large infrastructure environments.
	Experience managing critical power systems and building infrastructure.
	Effective communication skills in English Language demonstrated in oral and written business communications with people and business presentation skillsets.
	Working knowledge of:
	
		Windows 10 Professional or Enterprise operating system.
		HSEQ principles and methodologies of the local or global oil and gas industry would be an advantage.
	
	
	Working experience in sap pm, or other CMMS platform, Building Management system, MS Office suite, SharePoint, Forms, Power Automate and Power Apps would be an advantage.
